faqs.question: What is VCX-500 used for?
faqs.answer: VCX-500 is a 500 W, 20 kHz ultrasonic processor used for cell lysis, homogenization, emulsification, and nanoparticle dispersion, processing volumes from 200 µL to 1 L depending on the probe or accessory used.

faqs.question: How is VCX-500 different from VCX-750?
faqs.answer: VCX-500 shares the identical operating system and programmability as VCX-750, but runs at a lower 500 W power ceiling suited to small-to-medium volume work rather than the largest batch applications.

faqs.question: What sample volumes can VCX-500 process?
faqs.answer: Processing volume ranges from 200 µL to 1 L, with the exact range depending on which probe or accessory is fitted.

faqs.question: What does energy setpoint control do?
faqs.answer: Energy setpoint control doses sonication in Joules delivered rather than time elapsed, keeping results reproducible across samples that absorb energy at different rates.

faqs.question: What probe comes standard with VCX-500?
faqs.answer: A ½" diameter probe made from Ti6Al4V titanium alloy, with a replaceable tip, ships with the base configuration.

faqs.question: Can VCX-500 process very small sample volumes?
faqs.answer: Yes, dedicated microtip accessories extend processing down toward the 200 µL end of the range for small or precious samples.

faqs.question: Does VCX-500 support continuous-flow processing?
faqs.answer: Yes, a dedicated flow cell accessory adapts the system for continuous-flow sonication in addition to standard batch processing.

faqs.question: Can VCX-500 process multiple samples at once?
faqs.answer: Yes, multi-element probe accessories are available for processing several samples simultaneously.

longForm.heroHook: 500 watts of programmable ultrasonic power, from 200 µL microsamples up to 1 L batches.
longForm.heroLead: Not every liquid processing job needs 750 watts behind it. VCX-500 delivers the same programmability and precision on a scale suited to small-to-medium volume work. A 500 W, 20 kHz microprocessor-based system, it runs the same operating system and programming screens as the VCX-750, so switching between the two involves no learning curve. A standard ½" diameter titanium alloy probe with a replaceable tip ships with the system, and a full accessory line, probe options, microtips, cup horn, multi-element probes, and a flow cell, extends processing from 200 µL up to 1 L depending on what your application calls for.

sections.title: Product Information
sections.description: VCX-500 product information: power delivery, control features, and accessory ecosystem.
body: The system runs at 500 W maximum output and 20 kHz frequency, sized for small-to-medium volume liquid processing work.
It shares the same microprocessor-based operating system and programming screens as the VCX-750, so the two systems feel identical to operate despite the power difference.
Energy setpoint control doses sonication by Joules delivered rather than time alone, keeping results reproducible across samples that don't all absorb energy at the same rate.
Temperature monitoring runs alongside energy dosing, tracking heat buildup during processing for heat-sensitive samples.
A pulse mode handles applications needing intermittent rather than continuous sonication.
Wattage and energy display in real time, showing exactly how much power and total energy a sample has received during a run.
A 10-hour timer covers short bursts through extended processing runs.

A standard ½" diameter probe with a replaceable titanium alloy tip ships with the base configuration, and a dedicated accessory range, including probe options, microtips, a cup horn, multi-element probes, and a flow cell, extends the system across applications.

sections.title: Same Programmability, Right-Sized Power
sections.description: Choosing between VCX-500 and VCX-750 isn't a choice between a full-featured and a stripped-down system. It's purely a question of how much power your application actually needs. VCX-500 runs the identical microprocessor-based operating system and programming screens found on the VCX-750, so every feature, energy setpoint dosing, pulse mode, temperature monitoring, real-time wattage and energy display, carries over without exception. What changes is the ceiling: 500 W maximum output, sized for small-to-medium volume liquid processing rather than the largest batch work. For labs whose typical runs stay within that range, VCX-500 delivers the same reproducibility and control without paying for headroom that won't get used.

sections.description: Matching VCX-500's dedicated accessory line to your sample volume and application.
body: VCX-500 carries its own dedicated accessory range, built specifically around the volumes and applications this model is sized for. The standard ½" diameter probe, Ti6Al4V titanium alloy with a replaceable tip, ships with the base configuration and handles general-purpose work directly. Beyond that, a full set of probe options and microtips extends processing down toward the 200 µL end of the range, suited to small or precious samples. A cup horn accessory allows indirect sonication for samples in sealed vessels, multi-element probes support processing multiple samples simultaneously, and a dedicated flow cell accessory adapts the system for continuous-flow sonication rather than batch processing alone.
